definitions.explanation: A person's social standing as determined by the family they were born into. Often refers to the distinction or prestige of one's family background.

examples.japanese: {門地|もんち}による{差別|さべつ}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: Discrimination based on family status is not permitted.

examples.japanese: {日本国|にほんこく}{憲法|けんぽう}は{門地|もんち}による{差別|さべつ}を{禁止|きんし}している。
examples.english: The Japanese Constitution prohibits discrimination based on family lineage.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{門地|もんち}が{高|たか}い{家|いえ}に{生|う}まれることが{重要|じゅうよう}だった。
examples.english: In the past, it was important to be born into a family of high pedigree.

notes:
Composed of {門|もん} (gate, family) + {地|ち} (status, ground). Literally "the ground on which the family gate stands," referring to the social standing inherited through birth.

LEGAL CONTEXT:
This word appears in Article 14 of the Japanese Constitution, which guarantees equality: {人種|じんしゅ}、{信条|しんじょう}、{性別|せいべつ}、{社会的|しゃかいてき}{身分|みぶん}{又|また}は{門地|もんち}により...{差別|さべつ}されない ("shall not be discriminated against on the basis of race, creed, sex, social status, or family origin").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {門地|もんち}による{差別|さべつ}: discrimination based on lineage
- {門地|もんち}が{高|たか}い: of high pedigree
- {門地|もんち}を{問|と}わず: regardless of family background

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {家柄|いえがら}: family lineage, pedigree — more commonly used in everyday speech
- {身分|みぶん}: social status, standing — broader than family background alone
- {血統|けっとう}: bloodline, lineage — emphasizes genetic descent
